title: Lack of functions
body: A good app however the lack of apple music or spotify in the app is disappointing. There is also an issue with the goal set during the workout for example running... when my goal is achieved, i dont receive any notification or vibration alert. I have previously used Nike fitness app and it is by far better than this. These two issues have made me want to go back to Nike but the only thing stopping me is that i have a samsung gear fit 2. Please fix these issues and my rating will increase.
